big: A new price cap suddenly cuts the earnings of drug makers. A tax on foreign steel lifts local producers. Rules, taxes and incentives can change an industry's profits almost overnight.

lines: A regulator, a government body that makes and enforces them: SEBI for securities markets, RBI for banks. Import duty can protect local producers. A production-linked incentive pays firms for what they make in the country. Policy risk is the chance a change hurts the industry.
